entity.description: A report in Insights' catalog (design §6.1): one entry per report, owned by one app (review Z10); another app that shows the report mounts the owner's route. The entry grants nothing.

field.name: entryId
field.description: Stable: the owner app, a dot and the report (CustomerService.ServiceLevelCompliance); pins and saved references keep it

field.name: ownerApp
field.description: The one owner of the report (Sales, Accounting, ...)

field.name: description
field.description: What it answers, in the owner's words

field.name: purpose
field.description: The business purpose it is grouped by (Service, Sales, Finance, Inventory, Production, Projects, Catalog, Purchasing)

field.name: basis
field.description: Its date or status basis, as the owner states it

field.name: routePath
field.description: The canonical owner route, a path under /qapps; empty for a report opened from a record (Customer Service's CaseAnalytics)

field.name: definitionId
field.description: Or the report engine definition it opens

field.name: parameterContract
field.description: The shared parameters the route takes from Insights (comma separated: organizationPartyId, fromDate, thruDate, timePeriodId); any other is never passed

field.name: sourceReference
field.description: The owner's service or dataset that answers it

field.name: metricIds
field.description: The registered metrics it shows (comma separated)

field.name: catalogueService
field.description: The owner's catalogue service, called as the viewer, which decides whether the viewer reads the entry; empty: the route's screen authorization decides

field.name: catalogueKey
field.description: The report's id in the catalogue service's answer (its entryId, or Accounting's reportId, F17)

field.name: optionsService
field.description: The owner's service that answers the report's own options (get#ReportOptions); never a report run

field.name: exportFormats
field.description: The owner's exports (CSV); the route offers them

field.name: scheduleAdapter
field.description: An admitted schedule adapter (P7); without one the entry offers no schedule

field.name: readinessProviderKey
field.description: The readiness provider of its source, if any (P10's DataReadiness)

entity.description: A registered business metric (design §6.1, §6.2; review X11): the versioned descriptor of a measure its one owner defines in a domain report service or an admitted dataset. A panel names it in its body (business.metricId and metricVersion); a dataset definition may carry its own descriptor (body.business). The comparison rules of design §6.3 are its unit, aggregation and exclusion fields.

field.name: metricId
field.description: The owner, a dot and the measure (Sales.Orders)

field.name: version
field.description: Raised when its meaning changes; a panel naming an older version is told

field.name: serviceName
field.description: The registered domain report service that computes it

field.name: datasetIds
field.description: The admitted datasets that carry it (comma separated)

field.name: catalogEntryId
field.description: The owner's report that shows it, if any

field.name: grain
field.description: The record it counts or sums (order part, clock, asset)

field.name: aggregation
field.description: count, sum, ratio or snapshot: a ratio is recomputed from its numerator and denominator, a snapshot never summed across dates

field.name: unitPolicy
field.description: currency (native currencies apart, never summed across currencies), quantity (by product unit), percent, hours or count

field.name: requiredPermission
field.description: A permission needed to read the descriptor, when its meaning itself is restricted; the owner's service checks its data again

entity.description: A count of work waiting in one app's worklist (design §3 Attention): the owner's count service, called as the viewer, answers the count by the same query as the worklist the route opens with its filter.

field.name: providerKey
field.description: Stable: the owner app, a dot and the worklist (Purchasing.DraftOrders)

field.name: ownerApp
field.description: The app that owns the worklist and its query

field.name: title
field.description: The card's label, the owner's own (Draft orders)

field.name: description
field.description: What the count holds, in the owner's words

field.name: countService
field.description: The owner's service whose answer holds the count, called as the viewer; several providers may share one call

field.name: countParameters
field.description: Fixed parameters of the count call, as a JSON map ({"appRoot":"Purchasing"})

field.name: countField
overdueField
field.description: The path of the overdue part of the count, if the owner answers one

field.name: organizationParameter
field.description: The parameter, of the count call and the route, that takes the organization in Insights' scope (organizationPartyId); empty: the owner's own scope

field.name: organizationScope
field.description: The scope the count honors, as the card says it (Your active organization; The selected plant)

field.name: routePath
field.description: The worklist's canonical owner route, a path under /qapps

field.name: routeParameters
field.description: The worklist's filter, as a query string (view=draft); a value {path} is the count's answer at that path, left out when it has none (facilityId={plantId})

field.name: requiredPermission
field.description: A permission the worklist needs beyond its route (the owner's card shows only to its holders)

entity.description: A lifecycle participant (design §14): an owner of a kind of resource a user can own (a shared drive, a shared mail account, a calendar, a contact book, a work app's assignments, a report schedule), with its lookup of what a user owns, its transfer of one resource to a new owner and its pause of what runs for the user, each the owner's service carrying the owned-resource contract of org.moqui.admin.IdentityServices (define#OwnedResourceLookup, Transfer, Pause). ironstone.admin.LifecycleServices reads it for an offboarding preview and the steps of a lifecycle operation; the owner's services check their own permission and the new owner. The registration grants nothing.

field.name: participantKey
field.description: The owner app, a dot and the kind (commons.drives)

field.name: resourceKind
field.description: drive, mailAccount, calendar, contactBook, assignment, schedule

field.name: lookupService
field.description: What a user owns (define#OwnedResourceLookup)

field.name: transferService
field.description: One resource to a new owner (define#OwnedResourceTransfer); empty for a participant that only pauses

field.name: resourceParameter
field.description: The transfer service's own name for the resource's id (driveId)

field.name: pauseService
field.description: What runs for the user paused when access ends (define#OwnedResourcePause), if any

field.name: requiredPermission
field.description: The permission the owner's services check for another user's resources; a viewer without it is told the participant is not theirs to read

entity.description: A worklist a business flow map's step may open (design §9): the owner's canonical route and its typed parameters. A step stores the target's id and values for its parameters, never a path.

field.name: targetId
field.description: Stable: the owner app, a dot and the worklist (Commerce.Orders)

field.name: ownerApp
field.description: The app that owns the worklist

field.name: title
field.description: The worklist's name, the owner's own (Store orders)

field.name: description
field.description: What opening it shows, in the owner's words

field.name: routePath
field.description: The worklist's canonical owner route, a path under /qapps

field.name: parameterContract
field.description: The parameters a step may set, as a JSON map of the route's parameter name to its type: {"type":"choice","values":[...]} (one of the listed values) or {"type":"organization"} (the organization in the map's scope, set when the map is read, never stored on a step). A parameter not listed is refused.

field.name: requiredPermission
field.description: A permission the worklist needs beyond its route

entity.description: The class of a business dataset for Assist and MCP (design §1.2), and the domain that owns its source (design §11 SourceOwners). The row grants nothing.

field.name: datasetId
field.description: The report engine's dataset definition id (mantle-sales-orders)

field.name: domainOwner
field.description: The app whose records the dataset reads (Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, Warehouse)

field.name: classEnumId
field.description: Business operations, costs and margins, or People and payroll
